scope.purpose: Separate two groups of content with a thin line, horizontally or vertically, optionally with a short centered label.
useCases: Between sections of a panel, a card or a form.
Between groups of items laid out in a row (filters, metadata on one line).
A labeled break (Or, Today) between two blocks.
exclusions: Spacing: the layout's gap provides it; the divider adds no margin.
Separators inside Menu and Toolbar: those components keep their own child separator (same roles).
alternatives: Space alone (layout gap) or a container edge (card).
A heading to start a new section.

checks.name: npm run validate (schema, consistency, token coverage in 18 contexts, dependencies)
npm run build:tokens (coverage and contrast evidence)

decisionsTaken: Line in color.border.subtle and border.width.default, the roles of the Menu and Toolbar separators and the Tabs line, so that every separator of the system looks the same.
No margin of its own (the catalog: prefer layout primitives for spacing).
Optional label on horizontal dividers only, centered, typography.caption.md in color.content.secondary, space.content.sm on both sides.
Semantic separator by default; decorative hides it from assistive technology (Bits UI Separator).
